# StoreProof

> Honest, automated web accessibility compliance for EU-selling Shopify stores. StoreProof scans a store for WCAG 2.2 Level AA issues, automatically fixes the subset that can be safely fixed at the source (image alt text, theme attributes), flags the rest for human review, and produces the European Accessibility Act (EAA) accessibility statement and evidence pack a merchant's lawyer needs. StoreProof is NOT an accessibility overlay widget.

- [The proof](https://storeproof.co.uk/proof): the EAA accessibility statement and evidence pack a customer receives

## Position
- The European Accessibility Act (EAA) has applied to EU-facing online stores since 28 June 2025. Penalties are set per member state (reported maximums around €100,000–€250,000; Ireland carries criminal liability); enforcement is still early-stage. Microenterprises providing services (under 10 staff and ≤€2M turnover) may be exempt.
- Shopify does not make a merchant's store compliant; the merchant is legally responsible. Shopify themes cover only about a fifth of WCAG criteria.
- Accessibility overlays are discredited: the FTC fined a leading overlay vendor $1,000,000, and more than 800 overlay users were sued anyway. StoreProof fixes the source code instead of layering a widget on top.
- An automated scan reliably detects roughly 30–40% of WCAG issues. StoreProof fixes those automatically and flags the remainder for human review. It never claims a full compliance guarantee it cannot deliver.
